svg.text: Box 3 is the difference. Infineon's factory key signs whatever it is handed, so a Trust M binding

text.font-family: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, Atkinson Hyperlegible, Inter, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: rests on the ceremony and the operator's word (docs/mainnet/THREAT-MODEL.md).

text.font-family: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, Atkinson Hyperlegible, Inter, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: The brand key can only sign the chip's own description of slot 0, so that link rests on the chip.

text.font-family: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, Atkinson Hyperlegible, Inter, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Its root is the project Safe instead of a chip maker: issuance is the trust you extend.
